The cached decoder projection adapter follows PyTorch commit `5c4886908584029761b579af026dcfb627c84070`, `aten/src/ATen/cuda/CUDABlas.cpp`, for cuBLASLt descriptors, alignment, reduction policy and heuristic selection. The full upstream copyright and BSD redistribution notices are retained both in the adapter header and in LICENSE. The packed classifier readout kernel is newly authored.
